tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// lho phyogs 'byung po'i gtor ma bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje stabs kyis lhor gnas te// tsan+dan dmar po la sogs pas// phyi rol dkyil 'khor gru gsum bya/ der ni me tog dmar po dgram// nya skam dang ni sha skam dang*// sgog pa byi sku khrag gi snod// til gyi tsha mig khu ba rnams// khyad par du ni bdud rtsi lnga// rnam pa sna tshogs bza' ba dang*// sran ma lnga dang sran chen gyis// gang ba'i snod ni mdun du bzhag /tshom bu'am thig le bzhi bcu rtsa gcig dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bkod la/ rang nyid he ru ka la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bzlas pa ci rigs par byas la/ mchod pa dang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya dang*/ sngags 'di yis ni dgug par bya/ oṃ ba ta lī ma hā ba ta lī hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*// ri dang brag dang phug gi sa// yul gyi 'dab dang lam gyi shing*// khyad par du ni khyim stong dang*// stong dang thang dang sa steng dang*// khyad par gdol pa'i khyim gnas pa// nag po drag po drag chen po// lhas byin mnyam du brten pa dang*// nag po gtsigs pa 'jigs byed pa// dga' ba las 'das bgegs rgyal po// rgan byed ma dang drag mo dang*// 'jigs ma lha mo dka' zlog mo// rgyal mo dang ni rnam rgyal mo// thub med gzhan gyis mi thub ma// nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo// nag sbom rnal 'byor ma dbang mo// zla mo drag mo sdang ba mo// 'phyang ma sum cu'i dbang phyug ma// kaṃ bo tsi dang mar me ma// 'o byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma// drag gzugs ma dang gzugs chen ma// mche gtsigs ma dang thod can ma// thod pa'i phreng dang thod can ma// kha ṭ+wāṃ can ma mthu chen ma// ral gri dgra sta'i lag can ma// rdo rje'i lag pa gzhu lag ma// mkha' 'gro lnga yi de nyid dang*// las kun rjes grub byed pa yi// sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen mo// de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen mo// rdul med sbyor ba skye med ma// rdo rje dbang phyug ma bka' yis// thams cad thams cad 'ong bar byos// oṃ kak+ka ka da na ba/

ba ban+dha na/ kha kha kha da na/ sarba duṣ+ṭā nāṃ/ ha na ha na/ gha ta ya sarba bhū ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ zhes bya ba gsum gyis spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim la/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis so so la gdan phul nas/ so so la mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// drag po nag po nyid la dbul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa ru drā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du me tog dang*/ spos dang*/ dri dang*/ mar me dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ rol mo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan rnams la sbyar te dbul bar bya'o// khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcings te/ mdzub mo gnyis lu gu rgyud byas la/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭhā bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma dbul lo// de bzhin du/ drag chen mo la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ ma hā ru drā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ lhas byin mnyam du brten la dbul// oṃ de wā dāt+ta sa mā shri ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ nag po la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ kṛṣ+ṇā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gtsigs pa la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ a kā rā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ 'jigs byed la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ bi bhat+sā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ir+ghaṃ swā hā/ dga' ba las 'das nyid la dbul// oṃ nan+te tā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ bgegs rgyal po la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ bi nā ya kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ rgan byed ma la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ tsa muṇ+ḍī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ drag mo la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ gau rī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ 'jigs ma la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ bi bhat+sā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ lha mo dka' zlog ma la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ u ma de wī tsa mā ta rā ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/

rgyal mo la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ dza yā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ rnam rgyal mo la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ bi dza yāñce bā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ thub med la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ a dzī tā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma la dbul// oṃ a pa rā dzī tā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ nag mo bzang mo nyid la dbul// oṃ bha dra kā lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ nag chen mo la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ ma hā kā lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ nag sbom la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ s+thū la kā lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma la dbul// oṃ dzo ki nīn+d+rā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zla mo la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ tsan+d+rī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ drag mo la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ gau rī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ sdang mo la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ duṣ+ṭā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ 'phyang ma la ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ lam+ba kī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ sum cu'i dbang phyug ma la dbul// oṃ triṃ sha ta shwa rī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ kaṃ po tsi la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ kaṃ po tsī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ mar me ma la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ dī pā yai gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ 'o byed ma la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ tsuṃ bi n+yā gra mā was+thī ta yo gi nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ drag gzugs ma la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ gau rī rū pī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gzugs can ma la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ ma hā rū pī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ mche gtsigs ma la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ daṃṣ+ṭā ka rā lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ thod can ma la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ ka pā lī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/

thod pa'i phreng la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ ka pā li mā li nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ phreng ba can la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ mā le nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ kha ṭ+wāṃ can ma nyid la dbul// oṃ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ mthu chen mo la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ ma hā dhi ka gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ ral gri'i lag can ma la dbul// oṃ khaḍ+ga hasti nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā// dgra sta'i lag pa can la dbul// oṃ pa ra shu hasti nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ rdo rje'i lag can ma la dbul// oṃ badz+ra hasti nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gzhu lag ma la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ dha nu hasti nī ye gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod do// de nas mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la// zhes pa rnams kyis phrin las bcol la/ so so'i rgyud bskul nas dngos grub blang ba'i phyir sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa ru drā yai swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ru drā yai swā hā/ oṃ de ba dāt+tā sa mā shri ye swā hā/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa ye swā hā/ oṃ a ka rā lā ya swā hā/ oṃ bhat+sā ya swā hā/ oṃ nan+de tā ya swā hā/ oṃ bi nā ya kā ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa muṇ+ḍī ye swā hā/ oṃ gau rī ye swā hā/ oṃ bi bhat+sā yai swā hā/ oṃ u ma da bī tsa mā ta rā ye swā hā/ oṃ dzā yā yai swā hā/ oṃ bi dzā yañcai bā ya swā hā/ oṃ a dzī tā yai swā hā/ oṃ a pa rā dzī tā yai swā hā/ oṃ bha dra kā lī ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā lī ye swā hā/ oṃ s+thū la kā lī ye swā hā/ oṃ dzo gi nīn+d+rā ye swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+rī ye swā hā/ oṃ gau rī ye swā hā/ oṃ dūṣ+ṭā yai swā hā/ oṃ laṃ ba kī ye swā hā/ oṃ trīṃ sha ta shwa rī ye swā hā/ oṃ kaṃ po tsī ye swā hā/

oṃ dī pī yai swā hā/ oṃ tsuṃ pi n+yā gra ma bas+thī ta yo gi nī ye swā hā/ oṃ gau rī rū pī ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā rū pī ye swā hā/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭā ka rī lī ye swā hā/ oṃ ka pā li ye swā hā/ oṃ ka pā la mā li nī ye swā hā/ oṃ mā li nī ye swā hā/ oṃ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga nī ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā dhi kā yai swā hā/ oṃ khaḍ+ga sti nī ye swā hā/ oṃ ba ra shu hasti nī ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra hasti nī ye swā hā/ oṃ dha nu hasti nī ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags rnams re re la'ang brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzla'o// slar yang mchod de dngos grub blangs la bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa ru drā gats+tsha/ zhes kun la sbyar te gshegs su gsol/ rim pa 'di nyid kyis thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs par gtong ngo*// yongs su rdzogs pa dang las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// shin tu bsdus te gtong bar 'dod na/ spyan 'dren pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ sngags kyis spyan drangs pa'i mthar/ oṃ tis+t+wa hūm̐ zhes pa la sogs pa 'ba' zhig gis phul nas phrin las bcol la gshegs su gsol/ rgyas pa dang bsdus pa gnyis char gyis phrin las bcol ba'i mthar/ chos kyi sbyin pa dang bden pa'i stobs brjod par bya'o// lho phyogs su bya ba 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
